Sponsor: Almond
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 333 as introduced adds two members to the Alabama Justice Information Commission, which could increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency to provide travel expense reimbursement by an estimated $361 per meeting.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
